meta.name: Harness flow
meta.tagline: One task from the owner's ask to the notebook. Heavy outline: the owner decides. Green fill: the supervisor reads real state instead of trusting a message. Click any step.

labels.stageNote: **This is a part of the flow, not a step.** The boxes inside it are the steps, in order.
labels.anyNote: **Not one step.** These run all through the flow.

stages.name: Ask
stages.principle: The owner **asks**. The supervisor sorts the ask.
when: When a person wants work done → you are in Ask

stages.name: Instruct
stages.principle: **Write it down.** Then start one worker in its own copy.
when: When the ask is sorted → you are in Instruct

stages.name: Run
stages.principle: The worker **works**. Short status lines tell the supervisor where it is.
when: When the worker has started → you are in Run

stages.name: Check
stages.principle: The supervisor **reads real state**. It does not take the worker's word.
when: When the worker says done → you are in Check

stages.name: Decide and land
stages.principle: The **owner decides**. Only then does the work land.
when: When the checks are clean → you are in Decide and land

stages.name: Remember
when: When the task is closed → you are in Remember

categories.name: The ask
categories.principle: A task starts with a **plain-words ask** and a project and a mode.
when: When the owner states a need → owner-ask
When the ask is clear → intake
categories.chainWhy: A person speaks first. The supervisor sorts after.

categories.name: Brief and start
categories.principle: A worker gets **written instructions** and its **own copy**.
when: When the task is sorted → written-instructions
When the brief is written → spawn
categories.chainWhy: The brief must exist before the worker does.

categories.name: Work and report
categories.principle: The worker works. It reports **one line** per phase change.
when: When the worker is running → worker-runs
At each phase change → status-lines
categories.chainWhy: The lines come from the work.

categories.name: Real state
categories.principle: Read **git and the pull request checks**. A message is not evidence.
when: When the worker says done → real-state-check
When the change must pass a gate before push → review-gate
categories.chainWhy: Check the facts first. Then the gate.

categories.name: Scout path
categories.principle: A scout's report is checked by a **program** and for **open questions**.
when: When a scout says done → report-check

categories.name: The owner's word
categories.principle: Nothing lands on its own. The owner says **yes**, then it merges.
when: When the checks are clean → owners-word
When the owner says yes → merge

categories.name: Clean up
categories.principle: Remove the worker's copy only **after** the work has landed.
when: When the work has landed → cleanup

categories.name: Notebook
categories.principle: A lesson becomes a **proposal**. The owner **reviews** it.
when: When a task closes → memory-learnings
categories.chainWhy: One step. It feeds the next ask.

owner-ask.name: owner-ask
when: When the owner wants a fix, an audit or an investigation → [[owner-ask]]
owner-ask.whatItIs: **The owner decides here.** The owner talks to one agent, the supervisor, in plain words. The owner does not start workers by hand.

intake.name: intake
when: Once the ask is clear → [[intake]]
intake.whatItIs:
The supervisor sorts the ask into a **project** and a **mode**. A scout finds facts and writes a report. A ship changes code and ends in a pull request. A project can be added through the project-management skill.

In the task layer, an intake table sorts each card and splits a half-staff, half-code card in two. That table is **designed, not proven**.

written-instructions.name: written-instructions
when: Before any worker starts → [[written-instructions]]
written-instructions.whatItIs: The supervisor writes a **brief** for the task: the intent, the spec, the rules and a definition of done. The rules include: never push, one status line per phase change, ask before anything the owner must decide.

spawn.name: spawn
when: When the brief is written → [[spawn]]
spawn.whatItIs:
The supervisor starts a worker in a normal agent session in a visible terminal window. It does **not** use a tool's built-in sub-agents. The worker gets its own git worktree and its own status file.

**Evidence:** this site was built by one such worker.

worker-runs.name: worker-runs
when: While the worker holds a brief → [[worker-runs]]
worker-runs.whatItIs:
The worker does **one task** in its own copy. A scout writes a report. A ship opens a pull request. By default workers skip permission checks, so the brief and the review carry the control. A safer, model-reviewed mode is being trialled. It is **not** the default.

Hooks block some bad commands: shell file writes and secret prints. In the supervisor's own session, a guard stops unsafe directory changes.

status-lines.name: status-lines
when: At every phase change → [[status-lines]]
status-lines.whatItIs:
The worker appends **one line** to its status file at each phase change. A small bash watcher sleeps on all status files. It costs no model tokens. It wakes the supervisor only when something is actionable, and it writes that wake to a durable queue on disk so a restart does not lose it.

The supervisor reads the lines as a **claim**. The next step checks the claim.

real-state-check.name: real-state-check
real-state-check.trigger: git and PR checks, not words
when: When a worker reports a pull request → [[real-state-check]]
real-state-check.whatItIs:
**Evidence is derived here.** A script registers the pull request and its head commit, and arms a merge poll against the forge. A ready signal whose commit exists only in the worker's disposable copy is blocked. A draft pull request is refused.

The supervisor keeps the result. It does not repeat the worker's summary.

review-gate.name: review-gate
when: For a ship that uses the pre-push gate → [[review-gate]]
review-gate.whatItIs:
A pre-push gate (no-mistakes) validates the change before it goes out. A finding that asks the owner goes to the owner.

**Status: designed, not proven.** The full ship path with the gate was not run for this site.

report-check.name: report-check
when: When a scout says done → [[report-check]]
report-check.whatItIs: **Evidence is derived here.** Before a scout says done, a small program checks its report for Simplified Technical English (STE100-style) rules. This is **the owner's own addition** to a private fork. Then the completion gate holds the task if an owner question is still open.

owners-word.name: owners-word
when: When the checks are clean → [[owners-word]]
owners-word.whatItIs: **The owner decides here.** The supervisor tells the owner the pull request URL and what was checked. Only the owner holds the level that merges, sends, publishes or spends. A card leaves Review only on the owner's word.

merge.name: merge
when: After the owner says yes → [[merge]]
merge.whatItIs: **The owner decides here.** The change merges only on the owner's instruction. The merge poll then reads the forge to confirm that it happened.

cleanup.name: cleanup
when: Once landing is confirmed → [[cleanup]]
cleanup.whatItIs: **Evidence is derived here.** The supervisor tears down a ship's copy only after landing is confirmed. A refusal because of uncommitted or unlanded work is a stop-and-look result. Nobody forces it without the owner's say. A scout's copy is thrown away after its report.

memory-learnings.name: memory-learnings
when: When a task or session closes → [[memory-learnings]]
memory-learnings.whatItIs:
A session note is written. A tool proposes edits to the instruction files. **The owner reviews each one.** Facts enter long-term memory only after review. The next ask starts from those files.

**Status: runs daily; proposes rule edits; the owner approves** (as of 2026-11-02).
